title: Loth-cat
description: These feline creatures were natives to the grass lands of the Outer Rim planet of Lothal. Small, feisty, and temperamental in nature, Loth-cats have large, pointed ears, wide eyes, and sharp teeth and claws. They have their moments when they can be friendly and some have even been domesticated. Sabine Wren kept one in the communications tower she called home after the Galactic Civil War.
